fillInstructions.description: Behind the removed green body is a uniform bright-yellow background that continues seamlessly across the entire removed silhouette, including the neck area, the large lower mass, and the lower-center notch region.
continueEdges: Continue the surrounding yellow field straight through the former outer boundary of the green body.
Continue yellow through the interior cavity region so it merges with the existing yellow opening.

Around preserved non-removed objects inside/adjacent to the body cutout (top gray sign tile, black/blue marker, lower gray cap, lower maroon block), keep their edges intact with yellow immediately around them where green was removed.
fillInstructions.texture: Flat solid fill; no gradient, no pattern, no visible texture.
